extraction_scope: worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF/OA figures

mechanism_claims.claim_text: KW-13 damages Escherichia coli cell membranes in the paper's scanning electron microscopy assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct mechanism evidence is limited to E. coli morphology under the reported assay condition; it does not prove all targets or in vivo efficacy.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The authors interpret KW-13 activity in the context of cationic peptide interaction with negatively charged Gram-negative bacterial membranes.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is an author interpretation supported by SEM and literature context, not a separate binding or permeability quantification assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: KW-13 was designed as a cationic alpha-helical peptide and modeled with helix/random-coil zones.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural design/modeling supports mechanism plausibility but is not itself direct antimicrobial mechanism evidence.
